items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: Teddy Hill... he had orchestra, you know, and he gave up his orchestra, just to manage this place, you see? And he was like the master of ceremonies

ctx.x: Who were some of the other masters?
Well there's -- well he didn't live very -- I mean Hale, long, but he became one and Teddy Hill.
Tell me something about Teddy Hill. Hale I've heard he was an incredible dancer, but I -- since you were so close with him. How did you meet and what became of your careers together in the '60's?
